credentials.description: Notch Pay public key, sent as is in Authorization; a key containing test_ works in sandbox (same host for test and live)
Notch Pay private key, sent as is in X-Grant, for transfers, beneficiaries, balance and webhooks

example_prompt: Delete a Notch Pay webhook endpoint that is no longer needed.

parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.description: The webhook endpoint ID to delete.

gotchas: Deletion is immediate and irreversible. Notch Pay will stop delivering events to the endpoint right away.
The endpoint path parameter is the webhook endpoint ID, not its URL.
A 404 is returned if the endpoint ID does not exist or belongs to a different account.

Authorization takes your public key as is, with no 'Bearer ' prefix, and X-Grant your private key (Notch Pay's Authentication page: `-H "Authorization: YOUR_PUBLIC_KEY"` `-H "X-Grant: YOUR_PRIVATE_KEY"`).

This endpoint also requires the `X-Grant` header carrying your private key (`X-Grant: YOUR_PRIVATE_KEY`). Without it Notch Pay returns 403 "This endpoint requires additional authentication"; a wrong value returns 403 "Invalid grant key".
